items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The zyx.tw theme on top of stock shadcn/ui: full grayscale palette, stock radius, pure black dark mode, muted text at 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes. Init with the base preset and neutral color, then add this.

items.name: shimmering-text
items.title: Shimmering Text
items.description: Text with a shimmer sweeping across it — loading and streaming states. CSS-only, zero dependencies, respects reduced motion.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light/dark switcher for next-themes — hydration-safe icon, ghost icon button.
